info.title: SecretStream API
info.description: An API to anonymously share and view secrets. Allows submission and retrieval of secret texts without authentication.

get.description: Health check route to verify the API is running.

post.description: Submits a secret text to be shared anonymously. No authentication, user, or IP is tracked.

get.description: Returns a list of recently submitted secrets, ordered from newest to oldest. No authentication required.

200.description: A list of secrets submitted anonymously.

text.title: Text
text.description: The secret text to be shared anonymously.

SecretIn.title: SecretIn
SecretIn.description: Pydantic model for incoming secret submissions.

id.title: Id
id.description: An internal ID for the secret (not tied to identity).

text.title: Text
text.description: The secret text that was shared anonymously.

SecretOut.title: SecretOut
SecretOut.description: Pydantic model for secrets returned from the API.

tags.name: secrets
tags.description: Endpoints for submitting and retrieving anonymous secrets.
